name: Interpreter Attack

topology.shift: structural contradiction is relocated into alleged defect of the decoder

activation: a participant identifies a mismatch or contradiction
the validity of perception itself becomes the target
maintenance: uncertainty about the decoder replaces examination of the structure
signatures: you only see a contradiction because something is wrong with you
disagreement about the frame is treated as evidence of defective interpretation
falsePositives: good-faith correction supported by inspectable evidence

breakpoints.operation: separate observed data from competing interpretations
restore legitimacy of inspectable alternative interpretations
